A one-line notice with its consequence and at most two actions. It times out after six seconds with a visible timer; errors persist until dismissed. Toasts sit at the bottom right, or full width at the bottom on phones.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    **Drop-in.** The gate's toast after a sign-in that found an existing license ("Signed in as …").

    **Styled part.** `ToastView(text:tone:)` on a floating glass surface.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.toast(_:)`: an error toast stays until dismissed.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.
